title: fix(runtime): the action and security activation doors record which admin switched an item
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTXjaSjCiT9wP1UtogZiA8r)_

Part of #26474. This PR covers the action door and the security catalog door. The flow toggle half stays open on the card and waits on spec card #26506, which declares a caller channel on `IAutomationService.toggleFlow` (seat ruling `6434876664`, letter A).

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 管理员关掉一个打包的 action,或关掉安全目录里的职位、权限集、共享规则、webhook 时,激活台账行的 `created_by` / `updated_by` 和对应审计行的 `user_id` / `actor` 现在记的是这位管理员,不再是空。
- **为什么改:** 以前台账一律用不带用户的系统身份写入,审计记录说不出是谁停用了出厂功能。
- **风险与回滚:** 写入仍是提权写(权限不变),只是多带了调用者身份;没有调用者的写入(启动期等)照旧用系统身份。回滚 = revert 本 PR。flow 开关还没改,等 spec 卡 #26506。
- **先看:** `packages/core/src/utils/metadata-activation-store.ts`(`setActive` 的 context 与 `MetadataActivationWriteContext` 类型)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/activation-gate.ts`(`activationWriteContext`)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts` 写入处。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/activation-ledger-actor.dogfood.test.ts`(先按 CI 建好 dogfood 依赖闭包),预期 5/5 通过,台账行与审计行都写着登录管理员的 id。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/core`:** `ObjectStoreMetadataActivationStore.setActive(row, options?)` takes `{ context }`, which is the caller the write is made for. The keyed read and the insert or update all run under that context. The new type `MetadataActivationWriteContext` requires `isSystem: true`, so a door cannot pass the caller's context down without the elevation. There is deliberately no runtime read of `isSystem` in the store: that would be a new elevation read site for `check:system-context-census`, and the type plus the one shared runtime helper already carry it. Without a context the store keeps its system context, so a write that no caller requested (boot time, in-process) still names nobody. `MetadataActivationWriteOptions` is exported, and the `MetadataActivationStore` interface carries the optional parameter.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`:** `ObjectQL.setActionActive(row, options?)` and `ActionActivationProjection.setActive(row, options?)` pass the options to the store unchanged. `ActionActivationWriteOptions` is exported.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`:** a new `activationWriteContext(context)` in `domains/activation-gate.ts` returns `{ ...callerContext, isSystem: true }`, the caller's own execution context, elevated. Both doors call it after their two authority gates admit the caller:
  - `POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/:object/:action` (`domains/actions.ts`)
  - `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/:type/:name` (`domains/catalog-activation.ts`), which covers positions, permission sets, sharing rules and webhooks.

**Mechanism.** The elevation is kept, because the ledger object is engine-owned and only an elevated write reaches it. The caller is carried as the acting principal in the same context. The engine stamps `created_by` / `updated_by` from its `userId`, and the audit plugin reads `user_id` / `actor` from the same session. No actor is stamped by hand on any row. This is the `sudo()`-shaped elevation that `ObjectRepository.execute` documents. It is deliberately not `buildActionExecutionContext`, which also marks the context as an app-automation elevation.

## Why

Card #26474 (QA source #26468): on a stock showcase, a signed-in admin switched off a packaged flow and a packaged action, and all four actor fields came out null. The cause was that every door ended in `ObjectStoreMetadataActivationStore.setActive`, which wrote with a constant `{ isSystem: true, positions: [], permissions: [] }` carrying no user.

## Tests

Red first on `main` (`98c02577`): the test commits `6eed608a` and `2e0d5df6` precede the fix commit `773a999a`. The red was measured with the test commits on top of unchanged `main` source and a build of that source.

| Suite | On `main` | After the fix |
|:--|:--|:--|
| core `metadata-activation-store.test.ts`, new describe "the write names the caller who asked for it" (3 cases) | the insert and update cases failed (`expected { isSystem: true, positions: [], … } to deeply equal { userId: 'usr_admin', … }`); the no-caller case is a control and passes on both | pass |
| objectql `action-activation.test.ts`, "setActionActive hands the caller's write context through to the durable store" | failed | pass |
| runtime `action-activation-posture-gate.test.ts`, "the activation write names the caller who asked for it" (tenant admin under `single`, operator under `isolated`) | 2 failed (`expected undefined to deeply equal { userId: ... }`) | pass |
| runtime `catalog-activation-door.test.ts`, "the write names the caller who asked for it" (`position`, `permission`: insert then update) | 2 failed (both writes ran under the bare system context) | pass |
| dogfood `activation-ledger-actor.dogfood.test.ts` (showcase boot plus `AuditPlugin`, signed-in admin; action and position, off then on; ledger row and audit row) | 4 failed (`expected null to be` the admin id, on `created_by` and `updated_by`) | 5/5 pass |

Existing pins that read `setActionActive`'s single argument now read the second one with `expect.anything()` (`action-activation-posture-gate.test.ts`, `tenancy-posture-outage-gates.test.ts`, `scoped-service-miss-attribution.test.ts`). The `action-activation-unpackaged.test.ts` double now forwards the options to the real projection and store.

<details><summary>Ablation (one behaviour, one mutation): the doors hand down a context with no caller</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/runtime/src/domains/activation-gate.ts`. The anchor was `return { ...caller, isSystem: true };`, replaced by a marker-carrying `{ isSystem: true }`. Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime build`, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/runtime ABLATE_26474` (exit 0, marker in dist).

- Ablated: runtime door suites, 5 failed (the 4 new caller pins, plus the legacy empty-body pin that this run exposed as still reading one argument; that pin is fixed in a later commit). Dogfood: 4 failed, `expected null to be` the admin id.
- Restored: the blob equals HEAD (`651aa0c0`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight exit 0. Dogfood 5/5 pass.

</details>

Package suites, run under the verify lock. The final head is `c5672b2f`; its last commit changes only `@objectstack/core`:

- At `c5672b2f`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test` passed 122 files and 2791 tests. `typecheck` for core, objectql and runtime exited 0. Runtime `src/domains` passed 148 files and 4156 tests, and objectql `action-activation.test.ts` passed 19 tests. Dogfood passed 3 files and 24 tests: `activation-ledger-actor`, `catalog-activation-door` and `packaged-activation-ledger-reach`, on a rebuilt core.
- At `57a1b5e9` (the same runtime and objectql source): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` passed 472 files and 8790 tests. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` passed 457 files and 7426 tests, with 19 skipped.

The dogfood regression gate does not run on PRs or in the merge queue. The dogfood numbers above are the local run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Flow door: not in this PR.** `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/toggle` reaches the ledger only through `IAutomationService.toggleFlow(name, enabled)` in `packages/spec`, which has no caller channel, and the server lane does not edit spec. It waits on #26506 and stays the open half of #26474. Its ledger row and audit row are still null today.
- **Audit row organization.** This is read from code and not asserted. The audit writer stamps `tenant_id` from the session's `organizationId`, so an activation audit row written for a caller who has an active organization now carries that organization instead of null. Under `group` / `isolated` only the platform operator can write this ledger, and the operator's context has no organization.
- **Side note from the card (clone audited as `system`):** a different code path. The clone arm saves through `registerAndSaveFlow` (metadata protocol save, the `PutOptions.actor` family), not through the activation ledger. It is not carried here; see seat ruling `6434876664` item 3.

## Verification

Gates are derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff (71 commands), plus `eslint --no-inline-config` scoped to the touched files. All were run at `c5672b2f`, and every exit code was captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: **71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**.

- The first sweep reddened `pnpm check:system-context-census` (`[file-without-a-row]`): a runtime `isSystem` read in the store counted as a new elevation read site. Commit `c5672b2f` drops that read, because the type carries the elevation, and the re-run is green.
- `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first refused on the shallow clone (exit 2 and 3: a prerequisite, so nothing was measured). After `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-22 origin main` and a fetch of the self-test's control commit `621a4876`, both exit 0.
- Not local: the CI-only type-check lanes and the Build Core job, which are read from this PR's check runs. The dogfood regression gate does not run on PRs.
